methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page and, where the official page rendered JS-only/empty or returned 403/404 to automated fetch, from reputable aggregator sources (GetApp, Slashdot, AlternativeTo) cited in each vendor's provenance. accessedAt is 2026-06-14 on all sources. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical. monthlyUsd reflects the effective per-unit (per seat or flat plan) monthly cost; for annual-billing-only prices the annualized monthly rate is recorded and annualDiscountPct is set where both billing cycles are published. Quote-only and enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd: null. Vendors with no self-serve public price are still included with null plans and an explaining provenance.
